tagline: Leading specialty insurance and reinsurance provider serving global markets
hero_kpi_rationale: Robust 22.6% growth reflecting sustainable value creation through strong underwriting results, positive investment returns, and capital discipline. Key metric monitored by management to measure shareholder value creation.

kpis.name: Underwriting Income
kpis.explanation: Profit generated by insurance and reinsurance activities before investments, reflecting pricing discipline and portfolio quality.
kpis.description: Underwriting income is the sum of profits from the Insurance, Reinsurance and Mortgage segments. It reflects pricing discipline and portfolio quality.
kpis.signal: Underwriting income totals $3.0 billion in 2025 driven by strong performance across all three segments.

kpis.name: Net Premiums Written
kpis.explanation: Total amount of insurance and reinsurance premiums collected net of reinsurance, primary indicator of business volume.
kpis.description: Net premiums written increase due to the acquisition of Allianz activities (MCE) and growth in specialty lines.
kpis.signal: $16.5 billion in net premiums in 2025, driven by the MCE acquisition and organic growth.

kpis.name: Book Value per Share
kpis.explanation: Shareholders' equity divided by number of shares, a key measure of shareholder value creation.
kpis.description: Key metric monitored by management to assess shareholder value creation, reflecting underwriting results, investment returns, and share buybacks.
kpis.signal: Book value per share grows 22.6% in 2025, supported by strong results.

kpis.name: Operating ROAE
kpis.explanation: Return on operating equity excluding non-recurring items, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Measures operating performance on average equity, excluding realized gains/losses and non-recurring items.
kpis.signal: Operating ROAE at 17.1% in 2025, reflecting strong return generation.

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Final profit available to common shareholders after all expenses, claims, and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income available to common shareholders amounts to $4.4 billion, reflecting combined performance from underwriting and investments.
kpis.signal: Net income of $4.4 billion in 2025, driven by all three segments and investment returns.

kpis.name: Share Repurchases
kpis.explanation: Amount allocated to repurchase shares to optimize capital structure and create shareholder value.
kpis.description: Repurchases executed in the market, enhancing per-share value while maintaining financial flexibility.
kpis.signal: $1.9 billion in repurchases in 2025, with an additional $3.0 billion authorized in April 2026.

kpis.name: Insurance Underwriting Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from the insurance segment after claims and expenses, reflecting operational performance of the portfolio.
kpis.description: Driven by the MCE acquisition and growth in North America and international markets, with a 13.4% increase in net premiums.
kpis.signal: $375 million in underwriting income in the insurance segment in 2025.

kpis.name: Reinsurance Underwriting Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from the reinsurance segment after claims and expenses, measuring performance despite pricing pressure.
kpis.description: Strong performance despite 10% to 20% pricing pressure on catastrophe renewals, due to disciplined risk selection.
kpis.signal: $1.6 billion in underwriting income in the reinsurance segment in 2025.

kpis.name: Mortgage Underwriting Income
kpis.explanation: Profit from the mortgage segment after claims and expenses, reflecting portfolio quality and pricing discipline.
kpis.description: Strong fundamentals, pricing discipline, stable market share, and low delinquency rates support sustainable performance.
kpis.signal: $1.0 billion in underwriting income in the mortgage segment in 2025, fourth consecutive year at this level.

risks.title: Catastrophe Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to natural and man-made catastrophe risks that could have a devastating impact on its results and solvency.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has significant contractual obligations for claim payments and settlement expenses, as well as long-term debt of $2.7 billion.

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Rating agencies (claims paying and financial strength ratings) have a significant impact on the company's ability to underwrite new contracts.

risks.title: Liquidity Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company must maintain sufficient liquidity to meet its claim obligations and debt, particularly in the event of a major catastrophe.

risks.title: Rating Downgrade Risk
risks.score_rationale: A downgrade in ratings could lead to loss of investor and customer confidence, as well as higher debt costs.

risks.title: Reputation Risk
risks.score_rationale: Loss of customer and investor confidence could impact business activity and the ability to underwrite new contracts.

risks.title: Currency Risk
risks.score_rationale: Fluctuations in exchange rates could impact financial results due to international operations in Bermuda, UK, Europe, Canada, and Australia.

risks.title: Covenant Compliance Risk
risks.score_rationale: Failure to comply with covenants could lead to higher debt costs and reduced financial flexibility.
